audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer treats Justice Punch (E) as the matchup-defining tool. The lane is actually decided by Shield of Durand (W), the 18/17/16/15/14s charged taunt, because it is what catches Kled mid-E dash and blunts the remount burst behind its shield.
audit.why: Riot's W text: Galio charges a defensive stance and on release taunts and damages nearby enemies; flags carry hardCC and shield. Justice Punch is an 11/10/9/8/7s dash-knockup, a repeatable engage, not the punish window.
audit.corrected: Difficulty keyed to Shield of Durand's 18s rank-1 cooldown; Justice Punch demoted to a knockup to be respected, not the sole tracked cooldown. Content layer already had this right, so the two layers now agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Skill at Level 1, Skill at Level 6 and Kled at first item, contradicting both the packet chart and this page's own whys text.
audit.why: whys[0] states Skaarl's mounted stats out-stat Galio at level 1 (Kled). whys[4] states Level 6 is Galio's spike (Galio). whys[5] states first item only swings back toward even (Skill). The packet levelChart reads Kled/Skill/Skill/Skill/Galio/Skill/Kled.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4 and 5 flipped to Kled / Galio / Skill in both layers as a matched pair set; phases[5].why reworded so the first-item row no longer reads as a Kled row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer wrote 'beartrap' throughout; the ability is Bear Trap on a Rope (Q). The decisive interaction — Shield of Durand catching the E dash — was never stated, and Galio's passive Colossal Smash auto-reset tell was absent.
audit.why: Riot text for Kled Q: the target is shackled, and only if shackled for a short duration is it yanked toward Kled — so the hook lands first and the pull is cancellable. Kled E is a dash out-and-back; Galio W is hard CC with a shield, and his E creates terrain that blocks paths and dashes. Missing-interaction file flags both the displacement race (Q vs Hero's Entrance) and the Colossal Smash auto-reset tell.
audit.corrected: Real names used, Shield of Durand's 18s cooldown made the engage gate, Bear Trap's 11s rank-1 cooldown made the reason not to waste it on wave, and the taunt-eats-the-dash interaction stated outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere in the cooldown breakdown.
audit.why: Shield of Durand is 18s at rank 1, Justice Punch 11s, Bear Trap on a Rope 11s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the do's and the interactions report row.
